definitions: An open-source container-orchestration system for automating computer application deployment, scaling, and management.
A portable, extensible, open-source platform for managing containerized workloads and services, that facilitates both declarative configuration and automation.
examples: Many companies are adopting Kubernetes for their microservices architecture.
Learning Kubernetes can be a valuable skill for DevOps engineers.
The latest version of Kubernetes includes several new features.
